verdict: PASSED THE VERIFIER, FAILED THE SCIENCE. Not counted as census coverage.
what_happened: The first three HCLI census units were accepted by the numeric gate -- every required key present, valid disposition, no invented numbers -- and two of the three classifications are WRONG.

the_errors.Dream-v0-Instruct-7B: called 'LLM' / execution class 'instruct'. It is a DIFFUSION language model, which is the entire reason it is an interesting specimen.
the_errors.iLLaDA-8B-Base: called 'LLaMA-variant'. Also a diffusion LM -- measured as such in Epoch I's own cross-layer transfer run.

the_deeper_failure: execution_class came back as 'instruct' and 'high-throughput inference', which are not execution classes. The Odyssey sense is autoregressive decode vs diffusion steps vs encoder pass vs streaming. And all three dispositions defaulted to RESEARCH SPECIMEN.
why_the_gate_missed_it: the verifier checked NUMBERS against the measurement and required every key to be present. It never checked KNOWLEDGE. A confident wrong answer with correct arithmetic passes.
the_fix: two changes. (1) hand the body the config's own model_type and architectures as FACTS, since those are mechanical and it should not be guessing them. (2) require every agent to pass a CALIBRATION SET of specimens whose answers are already known from Epoch I before any of its verdicts are written. An agent that cannot classify a body we have already measured is not qualified to classify one we have not.
kept_not_deleted: this is the first measured evidence about which agent is fit for census work, which is Epoch II G018's actual question.
